title: SARS-CoV-2 Real-Time RT-PCR ORF1ab Protocol
author: Judy A Northill
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bchvit66
materials: SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit
Reagents SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One-Step qRT-PCR Kit Life Technologies Catalog #11732088

steps.title: Prepare Synthetic Controls
steps.instruction: Produce synthetic controls using the binary synthetic template oligonucleotide positive control for the in-house diagnostic real-time RT-PCR method.

steps.title: Set Up Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction mixture for use on a Rotor-Gene 6000 / Rotor-Gene Q 5-plex (using 100-place rotor discs) or an ABI 7500 Fast real-time machine.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a total reaction volume of 20µL per reaction, including a 'dead volume' of usually 2 extra reactions (adjust if using a robotic dispenser).
Dispense 15µl of the reaction mix into each reaction well.
Add 5µl of template, extracted RNA, controls, or NTC (nuclease-free water) to reach a total volume of 20µl.

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Evaluate the real-time fluorogenic PCR results based on the amplification curves.

substeps.instruction: Verify the presence of a sigmoidal curve (horizontal start, exponential rise, and horizontal plateau phase).
Confirm fluorescence intensity is at a suitable level compared to the positive control.
Identify the threshold (CT) value in the log-linear phase; a result is considered negative if it exceeds 40 cycles.
Ensure NTCs do not produce a curve.
